objective: Make Graph mechanically authoritative for product/schema pull requests and keep the Owner production gate unreachable until exact remote certification exists.

acceptance.description: Product/schema PRs require a coherent changed authoritative Graph task whose base and allowed paths cover the diff.
Only the controller can authorize and emit the canonical Owner migration readiness phrase.
Production gate requires exact remote PR head, required green checks, Vercel success, migration proof integrity, immutable applied migrations, and a committed task.
Failure ablation replays failing suites against the exact base and classifies HEAD_REGRESSION versus BASELINE_FAILURE.
Time-dependent employee directory coverage freezes its business clock and compiles TIME_DEPENDENT_TEST_CLOCK_RULE.
CI orders Graph/task/typecheck/affected checks before expensive suites without weakening full verification.
Focused regression tests and one exact-head GitHub CI run certify the release firewall.
